dossier.purpose:
Promptfoo (npm package `promptfoo` 0.123.1, MIT) is a TypeScript/Node CLI, Node library, local web viewer/server, MCP server and red-team toolkit that evaluates LLM apps from declarative configs (promptfooconfig.yaml/JSON/JS/TS). An eval is a matrix of prompts x providers x test cases (inline, CSV/XLSX with __expected columns, JSON/JSONL, script generators, Hugging Face datasets, Google Sheets). Each result row is graded by a list of assertions (66 base types in src/types/index.ts:605-672, plus not- variants, assert-set, select-best, max-score; deterministic checks, JS/Python/Ruby scripts, webhook, model-graded, trace/trajectory/skill checks). Rows are stored in local SQLite and exportable as json, jsonl, csv, html, xml, yaml and junit.xml.

Facts mapped to the three stated needs (presence/absence only, no judgment):
(1) Several scorers per labeled case with per-sample values kept: present. Each row stores score, success, failureReason, error, namedScores (keyed by assertion `metric`) and gradingResult.componentResults[] (one entry per assertion, each with its own pass/score/reason/assertion) in the eval_results table and in exported JSON (src/database/tables.ts:107-110; src/assertions/assertionsResult.ts:214-411; src/models/evalResult.ts:966-1026).
(2) Containerized end-to-end task-suite runner for the real Claude Code and Codex CLIs with a verifier per trial: no such built-in runner found (searched src/, examples/, site/docs for docker/container/verifier/harbor/terminal-bench/swe-bench). Promptfoo has providers that drive agent SDKs/CLIs on the host (anthropic:claude-agent-sdk, openai:codex-sdk, openai:codex-app-server which spawns `codex app-server`); each test row is graded by assertions; --repeat reruns rows. Container isolation is left to the user (docs suggest launcher wrappers; the Claude provider has a programmatic-only spawn hook; the OpenAI Agents provider accepts an Agents-SDK Docker sandbox client; a docs example wraps the separate Inspect harness for OSWorld). The `verifier` code in the repo is red-team security grading for coding agents, not a task-trial verifier.
(3) Declarative CI regression gate: `promptfoo eval` sets exit code 100 when pass rate is below a threshold (default 100%; env PROMPTFOO_PASS_RATE_THRESHOLD / PROMPTFOO_FAILED_TEST_EXIT_CODE), with JSON/JUnit outputs, a `validate config` command, a generated config JSON schema and docs for many CI systems. The packaged GitHub Action is a separate repository (promptfoo/promptfoo-action, not inspected). Skills and agents can be asserted with skill-used/not-skill-used and trajectory assertions. Gaps and pitfalls are listed under risks.

claims.claim: promptfoo is a CLI and library for evaluating and red-teaming LLM apps.
Promptfoo is now part of OpenAI. Promptfoo remains open source and MIT licensed.
Requires Node.js >=22.22.0 for npm and npx usage; Node.js 24 LTS is recommended.
Also available via `brew install promptfoo` and `pip install promptfoo`; `npx promptfoo@latest` runs any command without installing.
Test your prompts and models with automated evaluations.
Secure your LLM apps with red teaming and vulnerability scanning.
Review pull requests for LLM-related security and compliance issues with code scanning.
Developer-first: Fast, with features like live reload and caching.
Private: LLM evals run 100% locally - your prompts never leave your machine.
Flexible: Works with any LLM API or programming language.
Battle-tested: Powers LLM apps serving 10M+ users in production.
Data-driven: Make decisions based on metrics, not gut feel.

readme.telemetry_and_network: Local eval path: no account required; state is a local SQLite DB (src/database/tables.ts) and a disk response cache that is on by default with a 14-day TTL (src/cache.ts:38-51). Calls go to whichever LLM providers the config names; the default grader is chosen from whichever provider credentials are present (src/providers/defaults.ts:92-151,165-261). Telemetry is ON by default: each event goes to PostHog (https://a.promptfoo.app, only when the build embeds a key, injected at publish time from PROMPTFOO_POSTHOG_KEY: src/version.ts:34-35, package.json:93) and to https://r.promptfoo.app/ (src/telemetry.ts:126-175; src/constants.ts:43-46). Payload: event name and properties, package version, CI flag, Node version/platform/arch, a random user UUID kept in the global config, plus email, cloud-login status and auth method when present (src/telemetry.ts:44-51,76-82; site/docs/configuration/telemetry.md:22-31, which says prompts, outputs, test cases, API keys and full configs are excluded). PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 stops PostHog and normal events, but one 'telemetry disabled' acknowledgement event is still sent to r.promptfoo.app (src/telemetry.ts:110-124,158-174; site/docs/faq.md:60; SECURITY.md:78). Browser UI: posthog-js (click autocapture, masked session recording) initializes when the bundle was built with a key, and its disable switch is a build-time define (src/app/src/components/PostHogProvider.tsx:37-67; src/app/vite.config.ts:171-181); the server serves static files without runtime templating (src/server/server.ts:363-367), so by code reading the runtime env var is not consulted by the browser bundle (not executed or verified). Update check: GET https://api.promptfoo.dev/api/latestVersion on every CLI start unless PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE, auto-disabled when CI is set (src/updates.ts:14-33; src/main.ts:58-63). Conditional/hosted features: sharing via --share, or automatically once logged into Promptfoo Cloud (src/util/sharing.ts:59-64; share host api.promptfoo.app: src/constants.ts:11-25); red-team scans require an email (interactive prompt, placeholder in CI) checked against api.promptfoo.app plus a consent POST to api.promptfoo.dev/consent unless remote generation is disabled (src/node/doEval.ts:718-732; src/globalConfig/accounts.ts:161-257,259-312; src/telemetry.ts:198-221); red-team generation falls back to https://api.promptfoo.app/api/v1/task when no OPENAI_API_KEY is set or when logged into Cloud, and PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION turns it off (src/redteam/remoteGeneration.ts:30-43,73-80,164-189); regular llm-rubric/similar graders only use remote grading when the config has a redteam section (src/matchers/llmGrading.ts:200-237; src/matchers/similarity.ts:187-204); code scanning runs on Promptfoo Cloud by default (src/codeScan/scanner/index.ts:169; site/docs/code-scanning/index.md:80). Offline recipe and its stated limits (not a network firewall): site/docs/faq.md:112-126. Which data each hosted path sends is enumerated in SECURITY.md:58-81.

code.architecture: Single published npm package plus private workspaces src/app and site, with enforced layers (architecture/layers.json; docs/architecture/packages.md; `npm run architecture:check`). Flow: src/entrypoint.ts -> src/main.ts (Commander; commands in src/commands/) -> src/commands/eval.ts options -> src/node/doEval.ts (config resolution, test filters, run, summary, outputs, sharing, exit codes) -> src/evaluator.ts (expands prompts x providers x tests x repeats, calls providers under src/scheduler concurrency/rate limits, runs assertions, persists through the EvaluationStore port in src/evaluator/runtime.ts; default adapter src/node/evaluationStore.ts -> src/models/eval.ts and evalResult.ts -> src/database (Drizzle ORM over libsql/SQLite, drizzle/ migrations)). Grading: src/assertions/ (handlers; index.ts runAssertions; assertionsResult.ts weighted aggregation, named scores, thresholds) and src/matchers/ (model-graded helpers). Providers: src/providers/ (registry.ts maps ids; HTTP/WebSocket/browser/script/Python/Ruby/Go providers; agent providers claude-agent-sdk.ts, openai/codex-sdk.ts, openai/codex-app-server.ts, opencode-sdk.ts, openinterpreter; shared agentic-utils.ts for caching and working-dir fingerprints). Others: src/redteam/ (plugins, strategies, graders; src/redteam/plugins/codingAgent/graders.ts and verifiers.ts are security checks for coding agents, including a reader for externally produced verifier sidecar reports at verifiers.ts:3181-3336), src/tracing/ (OTLP receiver + trace store), src/server/ (Express API, CSRF middleware, static UI), src/app/ (React UI), src/commands/mcp/, src/codeScan/ + code-scan-action/ (PR scanner client; backend is Promptfoo Cloud), src/cache.ts, src/telemetry.ts, src/updates.ts, src/globalConfig/, plugins/promptfoo/ (agent-skill bundle), site/ (Docusaurus docs), examples/. Container-related code: nothing orchestrates containers for Claude Code/Codex; Docker appears in src/providers/docker.ts (Docker Model Runner, an OpenAI-compatible HTTP provider), src/providers/openai/agents-loader.ts:12,531-554 (Agents SDK DockerSandboxClient/UnixLocalSandboxClient), update-command helpers, and user-supplied examples (examples/integration-inspect-osworld/provider.py wraps the Inspect CLI, which owns the Docker sandbox, agent loop and scorer; examples/integration-docker/code-generation-sandbox uses a Python assertion with epicbox).

code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Vitest ^5 for backend, web UI and site (package.json:254,273); Python unittest for src/python (*_test.py, 2 files); Go test for src/golang (wrapper_test.go); a Ruby wrapper smoke step in CI. Approximate test files: test/**/*.test.ts = 899 (backend; includes 259 under test/providers, 147 under test/redteam, assertion tests under test/assertions, 16 smoke files in test/smoke/*.test.ts and 6 *.integration.test.ts that the default run excludes); src/app **/*.test.{ts,tsx} = 272 (web UI; browser config src/app/vitest.browser.config.ts); site tests = 16; total about 1,190. `npm test` = `vitest run` over test/**/*.test.ts(x) excluding integration and smoke files, random order, forks pool, 30 s test timeout, bail on first failure when CI is set (package.json:104; vitest.config.ts:15-17,28-35,44-52). Other commands: `npm run test:smoke` (built CLI end to end; vitest.smoke.config.ts), `npm run test:integration` (vitest.integration.config.ts), `npm run test:package-artifact`, coverage ratchets (scripts/checkCoverageRatchets.ts), `npm run architecture:check`, `npm run knip`, `npm run lint:ci` (Biome), `npm run tsc`. Project guidance for behavior changes is to run the real CLI (`npm run local -- eval -c <config> --no-cache -o output.json`) and inspect success/score/error in the JSON (AGENTS.md:122-174). CI: .github/workflows/main.yml on PRs, pushes to main and manual dispatch, jobs: ci-config + test matrix (Linux Node 22.22.0/24/26; Windows 22.22 in 3 shards on PRs and Node 24/26 shards on main; macOS 22.22 on PRs and 24 on main: lines 33-160), build on Node 22.22/24/26 (PostHog key presence check, package artifact test, built skill examples: 162-231), style-check (Biome, Prettier, dependency-version consistency, madge circular check, architecture boundaries, knip, lockfile-lint: 233-292), shell-format, assets (regenerated JSON schemas must produce no diff: 306-352), python (ruff + unittest on 3.9 and 3.14: 354-382), docs build, code-scan-action build, site tests, webui tests with coverage ratchets, integration tests, smoke tests (also sets up Node 20.20.0 and 22.22.0 binaries: 600-655), share-test against a local server, redteam against production and staging APIs (757-825), actionlint, ruby, golang. Other workflows: release-please.yml (release + publish), docker.yml (build, health check, publish), deploy-launcher.yml (Cloudflare Pages), promptfoo-code-scan.yml (project scans its own PRs), release-please-format.yml, release-please-sha-drift.yml, validate-pr-title.yml, validate-renovate-config.yml, image-actions.yml, two tusk-test-runner-*.yml.

code.security_policy: SECURITY.md at repo root: trust model says configs and code-executing fields (custom assertions/providers/transforms/hooks) run unsandboxed with user permissions, and the local web UI and MCP server are single-user dev interfaces (lines 5-27); hardening recommendations (101-115); supported versions are the latest published release only, no backports (117-125); report privately via GitHub Security Advisories (preferred) or security@promptfoo.dev, acknowledgment within 1 business day, fix targets Critical 14 days / High 30 / Medium 60, CVSS v4.0 (127-140,166-182); CVE and safe-harbor policies (193-256); in/out-of-scope lists (258-318).

claim_checks.claim: CLI and library for evaluating and red-teaming LLM apps (README.md:12).

claim_checks.evidence: Test cases take an assert list (src/types/index.ts:719-752); CSV __expected/__expected1..N columns become assertions (src/csv.ts:277-280); runAssertions runs every assertion and aggregates weighted score, namedScores by metric and componentResults per assertion (src/assertions/index.ts:754-884; src/assertions/assertionsResult.ts:253-411); each row persists success, score, gradingResult and namedScores (src/database/tables.ts:107-110) and exports them (src/models/evalResult.ts:966-1026; src/models/eval.ts:1431-1463). Caveats: PROMPTFOO_STRIP_GRADING_RESULT can null gradingResult in exports (evalResult.ts:534-542,1006); assertions sharing a metric name are merged into one weighted-average namedScore (assertionsResult.ts:275-290,351-355) though componentResults stay separate; no pass@k aggregation exists (--repeat only reruns rows: src/evaluator.ts:2668-2674).

Code: eval sets exit code 100 when pass rate (successes / (successes+failures+errors)) is below PROMPTFOO_PASS_RATE_THRESHOLD (default 100); exit code overridable by PROMPTFOO_FAILED_TEST_EXIT_CODE (src/node/doEval.ts:1040-1041,1290-1306; documented at site/docs/usage/command-line.md:169; unit test test/commands/eval.test.ts:2080-2112); output formats csv/html/json/jsonl/txt/xml/yaml/junit.xml (src/util/outputFormats.ts:5-17); `validate config` command (src/commands/validate.ts:569-587). risks: Scope: no Promptfoo component orchestrates containers or per-trial verifier loops for the real Claude Code/Codex CLIs. Agent providers run the SDK/CLI on the host (src/providers/claude-agent-sdk.ts:1830-1835,1908; src/providers/openai/codex-app-server.ts:844,1684); isolation is delegated to the agent's own sandbox settings (claude-agent-sdk.ts:790-850; codex-sdk.ts:311), a programmatic-only spawn hook (claude-agent-sdk.ts:968-986; site/docs/providers/claude-agent-sdk.md:905) or user-built launchers (site/docs/red-team/coding-agents.md:119-146). The project's own roadmap lists a side-effect harness and a real-eval QA matrix as future work (docs/agents/coding-agent-provider-taxonomy.md:452-472,520-537). Docker-backed examples wrap other harnesses (Inspect/OSWorld: examples/integration-inspect-osworld/provider.py:1-5) or run user scripts (site/docs/guides/sandboxed-code-evals.md:94-147). The code named `verifier` is red-team security grading (src/redteam/plugins/codingAgent/verifiers.ts:3477-3517).

CI-gate pitfalls (code prevails over docs): several CI pages recommend `eval --fail-on-error` (site/docs/integrations/ci-cd.md:115; n8n.md:70; aws-codecommit.md:52; travis-ci.md:76; azure-pipelines.md:92; bitbucket-pipelines.md:57,91) but no such option is defined (src/commands/eval.ts:36-180; not executed here). The built-in gate is an absolute pass-rate threshold (default 100%, errors counted as non-passing) giving exit 100 (src/node/doEval.ts:1040-1041,1290-1306); no baseline-vs-candidate diff gate was found in src/commands (searched). By code reading, a run that produces zero graded rows gives passRate NaN so the failure exit code is not set (doEval.ts:710-715,1041,1295); tests with no `assert` pass with score 1 (src/assertions/index.ts:773-775; assertionsResult.ts:215-222); `weight: 0` assertions are forced to pass (src/assertions/index.ts:671-677). The project's own skill guidance adds an explicit nonzero-coverage gate and tests it (plugins/promptfoo/skills/promptfoo-evals/references/eval-patterns.md:229-242; test/smoke/agent-skill-examples.test.ts:368-393).

Cached results can mask regressions: the response cache is on by default with a 14-day disk TTL (src/cache.ts:38-51); the Claude and Codex agent providers read it too (src/providers/claude-agent-sdk.ts:1756-1788; src/providers/openai/codex-sdk.ts:2277) with a working-dir fingerprint based on file mtimes, not content (src/providers/agentic-utils.ts:94-153); CI docs restore the promptfoo cache across runs (site/docs/integrations/ci-cd.md:151-168) while the project's gate snippet uses --no-cache (eval-patterns.md:237). An unset grader falls back to whichever provider credentials exist (src/providers/defaults.ts:92-151), so grading can differ between environments.

Security model: configs and custom assertions/providers/transforms/hooks execute unsandboxed with user permissions (SECURITY.md:9-13). The MCP HTTP server has no auth or CSRF middleware and both it and the web server call listen(port) with no host argument while logging localhost (src/commands/mcp/server.ts:154-174; src/server/server.ts:552-558); no code in src/ reads the HOST variable the Dockerfile sets (Dockerfile:68); SECURITY.md:113-114 tells operators to bind to loopback themselves and treats same-network access and the best-effort CSRF checks as out of scope (SECURITY.md:21-27; src/server/middleware/csrfProtection.ts:53-115). Self-hosting docs state no built-in auth and not recommended for production (site/docs/usage/self-hosting.md:36-46).

Telemetry and hosted dependencies: telemetry is on by default and can include a user UUID plus email/login status; the opt-out still sends one acknowledgement event (src/telemetry.ts:110-124,158-174); the browser UI's analytics switch is a build-time define (src/app/vite.config.ts:171-181); red-team scans need an email verified against api.promptfoo.app (src/node/doEval.ts:718-732); code scanning runs on Promptfoo Cloud by default and self-hosting is Enterprise On-Prem (site/docs/code-scanning/index.md:80); logging in to Cloud turns on automatic result sharing (src/util/sharing.ts:59-64); the README claim that prompts never leave the machine holds only for orchestration and storage (README.md:77).

Maintenance and versioning: pre-1.0 (0.123.1) with release-please pre-major bump flags (release-please-config.json:16-17) and releases dated 2026-08-04, 08-26, 08-28, 09-10 and 09-18 (CHANGELOG.md:275,199,192,82,7); the project is now part of OpenAI (README.md:23). Agent-runtime SDKs are optional pre-1.0 dependencies (package.json:278,297) and the docs warn an older Codex SDK or binary may silently ignore settings (site/docs/providers/openai-codex-sdk.md:638). Recent changelog entries fix grader failures that could be inverted into passes and failure rows lost when scoring fails (CHANGELOG.md:27,52,77), so grader-error semantics have recently changed.

Release integrity: npm publish uses --provenance via OIDC, and the GHCR image and code-scan-action bundle get GitHub build-provenance attestations (release-please.yml:111,392-423; docker.yml:414-437), but the workflows generate no checksum files, cosign/Sigstore signatures or SBOMs, and the Homebrew formula/PyPI package named in the README are not produced here. CI downloads actionlint from its main branch (main.yml:837-840). Published builds embed an analytics key at publish time (package.json:93).

Upstream check tolerance and evidence base: CI sets PROMPTFOO_IGNORE_UNHANDLED_TEST_ERRORS=true so vitest worker crashes/unhandled errors after passing tests do not fail the job (.github/workflows/main.yml:128-134; vitest.config.ts:54-75); the 'Redteam (Staging API)' job is continue-on-error (main.yml:822-825) and the production-API redteam job needs live network (main.yml:757-782); smoke, integration and unit suites are separate commands (package.json:98-104). All benchmark-style numbers in the repo are project-authored docs runs; no third-party measurement of the tool itself was found.

checks.statement: README does not mention Claude Code or Codex. The agent-skill bundle plugins/promptfoo (four skills) is published for Claude Code via .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and for Codex via .agents/plugins/marketplace.json. Providers: anthropic:claude-agent-sdk (alias anthropic:claude-code); openai:codex-sdk (alias openai:codex); openai:codex-app-server (alias openai:codex-desktop), which spawns `codex app-server --listen stdio://`; plus opencode:sdk and openinterpreter. Agent SDKs are optionalDependencies loaded lazily. skill-used and trajectory:* assertions exist; Codex skill calls are inferred from SKILL.md reads. The repo's .claude/settings.json defines lint/format and block-no-verify hooks.
checks.note: In README.md, 'claude' appears only in an image filename (line 64), and neither Codex nor MCP appears. agent-skill.md:12 names the four skills and both marketplaces; both marketplace.json files point to ./plugins/promptfoo, and both plugin.json files exist. registry.ts:278-279, 1000 and 1021 match the IDs and aliases. codex-app-server.ts:844 calls spawn, 1684 builds the ['app-server','--listen','stdio://'] args, and 1749 defaults the command to 'codex'. package.json:278 is @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk and :297 is @openai/codex-sdk, both optional. The SDK import in claude-agent-sdk.ts:37-55 is type-only, and the runtime load uses importModule (claude-agent-sdk.ts:344-366; codex-sdk.ts:638-658). types/index.ts:660-665 lists skill-used plus five trajectory types, and skill.ts:195-205 is handleSkillUsed. Taxonomy doc lines 199 and 209 state the SKILL.md heuristic. .claude/settings.json matches. Minor: the SKILL.md path matching itself is at codexSkillMetadata.ts:72,88; the cited 111-131 is the aggregation step.

checks.statement: verified: partial. eval sets exit code 100 when the pass rate is below PROMPTFOO_PASS_RATE_THRESHOLD (default 100), overridable by PROMPTFOO_FAILED_TEST_EXIT_CODE; output formats csv/html/json/jsonl/txt/xml/yaml/junit.xml; a `validate config` command exists. Mismatch: site/docs/integrations/ci-cd.md:115 and six other pages tell users to run `eval --fail-on-error`, but no such option is defined under src/. The GitHub Action is a separate repository.
checks.citation: src/node/doEval.ts:1040-1041,1290-1306; site/docs/usage/command-line.md:102-146,169; test/commands/eval.test.ts:2080-2112; src/util/outputFormats.ts:5-17; src/commands/validate.ts:569-587; src/commands/eval.ts:36-180; site/docs/integrations/ci-cd.md:115; site/docs/integrations/github-action.md:8
checks.note: The substance holds. doEval.ts:1040-1041 computes passRate over successes+failures+errors; 1290-1306 applies the threshold and exit code. eval.ts:36-180 has no --fail-on-error, and nothing in src/ matches it. The command-line.md:102-146 option table lacks it, and :169 documents exit code 100. The formats come from types/index.ts:1544-1553 plus junit.xml (outputFormats.ts:9). validate.ts:569-582 defines `validate config`. eval.test.ts:2080-2112 tests a custom exit code. github-action.md:8 links promptfoo/promptfoo-action. The error is a count: a case-insensitive search of the whole repo finds `fail-on-error` in exactly six files, ci-cd.md plus five others (n8n.md, aws-codecommit.md, travis-ci.md, azure-pipelines.md, bitbucket-pipelines.md). That is five other pages, not 'six other pages', and matches the six pages listed in the dossier's own risks entry.
